result.instructions: Tools for flespi, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our trackers have not reported a position in the last hour?"; "Show the latest ten messages from device 12345 with position and speed."; "List all devices that use the Teltonika protocol and their names.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes flespi data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run flespi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run flespi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run flespi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. flespi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: flespi_get_token_info
tools.title: Get token information
tools.description: Show the flespi token this server uses: its id, customer id, enabled and blocked state, expiry, and access rules. Good first call to check the connection. flespi API: GET /auth/info.

tools.name: flespi_list_devices
tools.title: List devices
tools.description: List devices (trackers and other connected units) with their id, name, protocol, telemetry and configuration. Use selector "all" or a filter such as "protocol_name=teltonika". flespi API: GET /gw/devices/{selector}.

selector.description: flespi selector: "all", comma-separated ids ("12,34"), or a field filter ("protocol_name=teltonika").

fields.description: Fields to return, e.g. ["id","name","telemetry"]. Omit for the default fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

offset.description: Number of items to skip before the first result.

tools.name: flespi_get_device_telemetry
tools.title: Get device telemetry
tools.description: Read the latest telemetry values of devices, such as position, speed, fuel or ignition. telemetry_selector "all" returns every parameter. flespi API: GET /gw/devices/{selector}/telemetry/{telemetry_selector}.

selector.description: flespi selector: "all", comma-separated ids ("12,34"), or a field filter ("protocol_name=teltonika").

tools.name: flespi_list_device_messages
tools.title: List device messages
tools.description: Read the most recent stored messages of devices, optionally between two UNIX timestamps and limited to some fields. flespi API: GET /gw/devices/{selector}/messages with the data filter.

selector.description: flespi selector: "all", comma-separated ids ("12,34"), or a field filter ("protocol_name=teltonika").

from.description: UNIX timestamp, inclusive. Omit for no lower bound.

to.description: UNIX timestamp, inclusive. Omit for no upper bound.

tools.name: flespi_create_device
tools.title: Create devices
tools.description: Create one or more devices. Each object must include device_type_id and configuration, for example {"name":"Van 4","device_type_id":1,"configuration":{"ident":"<IMEI>"}}. Creates new records; it does not change existing devices. flespi API: POST /gw/devices.

devices.description: Device objects to create (flespi device fields).

tools.name: flespi_update_device
tools.title: Update devices
tools.description: Change the properties of the devices matched by selector, for example {"name":"Van 4 (depot)"}. Only the given fields change. flespi API: PUT /gw/devices/{selector}.

selector.description: Devices to update: comma-separated ids ("12,34") or a filter ("protocol_name=teltonika"). "all" is refused.
